title: Account for the published-vs-estimator dual-attack cost gap at FIPS 203 parameters
what_this_is: A cost-model derivation on a pinned instrument. NOTHING WAS MEASURED. No ML-KEM break is claimed and no security proof is claimed. No hypothesis status is asserted and no heuristic is declared validated or refuted.

certificate.why: This run claims no discrete-log solve and no factor-base relation. There is no certificate family here for a wrapper to re-verify: the objects are cost-model outputs and algebra over them. proof_status is 'derivation'.

rule12_status.detail: Nothing in this package changes, corrects, or treats as corrected EV-MLKEM-011, EV-MLKEM-013, EV-MLKEM-017, KN-FIND-012 or KN-FIND-014. Section 7 of gap_report.md surfaces an observation in tension with one EV-MLKEM-015 observation and explicitly declines to adjudicate it, leaving that to the Coordinator/Reviewer.

headline_observations.negative_residual_note: A negative residual means the additive chain OVER-attributes: the re-optimised estimator is cheaper than Carrier's published figure at Kyber-512 and Kyber-768. Recorded, not suppressed; the honest attribution lies between the D1-only and D1-D4 rows.

anomalies.what: Internal inconsistency observed in the pinned estimator, recorded not repaired: estimator/lwe_dual.py:589-597 feeds `beta_sieve if beta_sieve else beta` into Nf, so the AUTOMATIC path evaluates the sample-count formula at beta_sieve = beta (the estimator's own comment reads '# We assume here that beta_sieve ~ beta') while charging the reduction at the balanced sieve dimension GJ21.short_vectors picks. Passing beta_sieve explicitly changes both, so stage 4 is not a pure relaxation.
anomalies.impact: D4 is 0 at Kyber-768 and Kyber-1024 and +0.305928 at Kyber-512; the stage-4 docstring in dual_gap_decomposition.py states this
anomalies.recorded_because: it is an unexpected observation about the instrument and it bounds how stage 4 may be read

anomalies.what: Under RC.MATZOV at the pin, estimator.lwe_dual.matzov is CHEAPER than primal_bdd on all three sets (by 0.543432 / 4.592472 / 8.387943 bits at stage 1). EV-MLKEM-015 records 'Dual does not beat primal', which is true of the function it names, dual_hybrid+fft.
anomalies.handling: SURFACED, NOT ADJUDICATED. gap_report.md section 7 states explicitly that this is not asserted to correct, contradict or qualify EV-MLKEM-015, and that whether it rises to a rule-12 'contradiction of established evidence' is a Coordinator/Reviewer determination. Recorded because suppressing it would be the failure AGENTS.md rule 9 names.

anomalies.what: Internal discrepancy in the archived Carrier source: summing the three archived Table C.2 CC terms gives 139.510031 / 194.810446 / 259.350009, which reproduces the abstract's Kyber-512 headline 139.5 to 0.0100 bits but sits 0.2896 / 0.3500 bits below the 195.1 / 259.7 headlines. Table 5.1 itself is not in the archive.
anomalies.impact: 0.29-0.35 bits of the Kyber-768/1024 residual belongs to the source, not to an estimator/publication disagreement
anomalies.recorded_because: it is part of the residual and must not be silently attributed to the estimator

randomness.why_empty: The derivation is deterministic: the estimator's optimisers and this script's grid searches are exhaustive over declared ranges. There is no sampling, no Monte Carlo step and no RNG on any code path exercised.
randomness.reproduction_check_note: NOT PERFORMED, and stated as not performed: the budget allows one results-bearing run and it was spent on the deliverable. A re-run from the recorded command is expected to reproduce every cost figure exactly, but results.json can never be byte-identical because it records started_utc, finished_utc, wall_seconds_total and per-stage wall_seconds. An independent reproduction should compare the numeric fields, not the file hash.

executor_assessment.scope_of_what_is_established: One instrument, one pin, one reduction cost model, three FIPS 203 parameter sets, and exactly three estimator functions (primal_bdd, dual_hybrid(fft=True), matzov). The Sage cover for the matzov path is Kyber512 only (CTRL-3); Kyber768 and Kyber1024 matzov figures are an uncovered path.
executor_assessment.what_is_not_established: Nothing about ML-KEM security in either direction. No heuristic is validated. KN-OPEN-016's actual question -- whether the MATZOV-family success probabilities survive the Ducas-Pulles objection -- is untouched, and the estimator's matzov inherits the very sample-count law that objection targets.
